en.bilal-muhammad: Muhammad b. al-Hasan b. Ahmad b. al-Walid (ra) narrated to us. He said: Muhammad b. al-Hasan al-Saffar narrated to us from Salama b. al-Khattab from Ibrahim b. Muhammad from `Imran al-Za`farani from al-Sadiq Ja`far b. Muhammad (as).
He said: There is no man who prays and completes his prayer with “whatever Allah wishes – there is no strength except by Allah” (mashaAllah, la quwwata illa billah) except that his Owner answers.
